mapper.insert: INSERT INTO snaps (user_id, snap_title, coord_image, product_image, category, style, color, price) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{snap_title}, #{coord_image}, #{product_image}, #{category}, #{style}, #{color}, #{price})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM snaps ORDER BY snap_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE snaps SET snap_title = #{snap_title}, coord_image = #{coord_image}, product_image = #{product_image}, category = #{category}, style = #{style}, color = #{color}, price = #{price} WHERE snap_id = #{snap_id}
